policy: A weak input lowers confidence. It never fabricates an adjustment. Rumor and undated social posts are not verified.

features.label: Quarterback availability
features.note: ESPN public injury API: 32 NFL teams with a QB listed (Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Active). NCAAF feed is sparse (3 teams). Not a depth chart. Unresolved QB still blocks issuance.

features.label: Official injury report
features.note: NFL 32/32 team reports. NCAAF 3 teams. Timestamped ESPN statuses, not the league PDF. Missing NCAAF report still fails that league's context gate.

features.label: Kickoff weather
features.note: NWS hourly at canonical stadium coordinates for WATCH homes; ESPN scoreboard weather as a second stamp. Not a model adjustment until both agree.

features.label: Neutral-site / venue
features.note: ESPN game venue name cross-checked against the canonical stadium table. Neutral flag remains a board boolean.

features.label: Rest, travel, time-zone
features.note: Away-home stadium miles and tz delta for WATCH rows. Week-1 rest is opener (no prior NFL week). Not chained bye-week rest yet.

features.label: Public betting share
features.source: sportsbettingdime.com (ticket % + money/handle %) + scoresandodds.com + wagertalk.com + actionnetwork.com + sportsbookreview.com + covers.com contests
features.note: Bet/pick % on 356/1159 library games. Money/handle % on 209 (SportsBettingDime live 86, matched 105; ScoresAndOdds live 84; WagerTalk live 2; ESPN finals overlay 0; prior snapshots persisted). Ticket volume on 415. SBR 95, Covers 109. 40 games show a 10-pt+ money−ticket divergence.
